summary.headline: Planetary Significations in the Horoscope
summary.text: Chapter 47 begins the planetary significations in the individual places of the natal chart, starting with the planets in the Horoscope. Saturn through the Moon are associated with specific effects in the first house, including hardship, honor, conflict, power, pleasure, learning, dominion, and travel; Hermes is cited as an authority.
